title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #18: Pecos River, Red Bluff Reservoir and Davis Mts., Texas
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#18" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Red Bluff Reservoir", "Pecos River", "Pecos", "Apache Mts.", "Davis Mts." and "Rio Grande R.", with further labels near the lower right. Scratches and light streaks cross the print.
